## AI Blog Draft Generator to WordPress

Turn a topic and three bullet points into a structured WordPress draft - you stay the editor, the AI does the blank-page part.

**Setup time:** 15 minutes  ·  **Level:** Intermediate

**You'll need accounts/credentials for:** OpenAI, WordPress

**Setup steps:**
1. Add your OpenAI API key in the OpenAI node.
2. Connect WordPress: your site URL plus an Application Password (Users > Profile > Application Passwords).
3. Open the Form Trigger node and copy the production form URL - bookmark it.
4. Activate the workflow, submit a test topic, and check Posts > Drafts in WordPress.

Free templates and updates: navkhan103.github.io

### How it runs

Starts from **Draft Request Form**.

1. An n8n Form Trigger gives you a hosted form with topic, audience, and key-points fields.
2. An OpenAI node writes a structured draft in clean HTML: title, intro, H2 sections built from your key points, and a conclusion with a call to action.
3. A Code node splits the AI output into title and body.
4. A WordPress node creates the post with status 'draft' so nothing goes live without your edit.

### If something breaks

The read and AI nodes here **retry 3× automatically** (5s apart), which absorbs rate limits and brief timeouts.

Nodes that **send or write deliberately do not retry** — a send that reached the far end but lost its response would otherwise fire twice, so you'd get duplicate messages or duplicate rows.

To be told when one of those fails, build a workflow starting with an **Error Trigger** node that posts to Slack or email, then set it under **three-dot menu > Settings > Error Workflow**. Do it once and point every workflow at it.
